newsitem.title: USA: Telscape names Manuel Landa chairman.
newsitem.headline: Telscape names Manuel Landa chairman.

text.p: Telscape International Inc, which was formerly known as Polish Telephones and Microwave International Inc, said on Monday that it has elected Manuel Landa chairman.
Landa is chief executive officer of Telereunion, which merged with the company in May, Telscape said.
Landa replaces Gary Panno as chairman.
Telscape also said it is restructuring its Polish operations and eliminating 25 percent of its workforce there. A company spokeswoman said 40 to 45 employees presently work there.
The Telscape spokeswoman said the company does not anticipate taking a restructuring charge for the Polish operations.
The company also said it has received a $1 million equipment and network outsourcing contract with Camino Real Hotel in Tijuana, Mexico.
